from collections import deque
H,W=I.shape
def comps(wrap):
    seen=np.zeros_like(I,bool);res=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r,c]==1 and not seen[r,c]:
                q=deque([(r,c)]);seen[r,c]=1;cells=[]
                while q:
